text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Mmh?! Someone's voice just now... Where 
are you!? Don't hide, come on out!!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Ah! The Three Goddesses! Was that voice 
just now the Three Goddesses!?

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Did you just call for Turbo!? What do you 
need!?
